method: Rows of moe-general-information-of-schools.csv with dgp_code (planning area) in ['BUKIT BATOK', 'BUKIT MERAH', 'BUKIT TIMAH', 'CLEMENTI', 'JURONG EAST', 'NEWTON', 'ORCHARD', 'QUEENSTOWN', 'RIVER VALLEY', 'SINGAPORE RIVER', 'SOUTHERN ISLANDS', 'TANGLIN', 'WESTERN ISLANDS'], unchanged, plus OneMap geocode columns. Query is the 6-digit postal_code (zero padded); a result matches when POSTAL equals it. exact: all matches within 1 m; ambiguous: matches more than 1 m apart, first used; unmatched: no match. Coordinates are SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y and WGS84 lat/long from OneMap.
purpose: MOE school locations; clipped to Queenstown (plus buffer) by build_queenstown_geography.R.
